What We Do

Our Services

Get a Quote
🎨
Vehicle Wraps

Full and partial vinyl wraps in any colour or finish. Transform your vehicle's look completely with precision-cut film and a flawless install.

🪟
Window Tinting

Ceramic and carbon tint films that block UV rays, reduce heat, and give your vehicle a sleek, private appearance — fully Ontario-compliant.

🛡️
Ceramic Coating

Professional-grade nano-ceramic protection for interior and exterior. Repels water, dirt, and UV damage while delivering a deep, permanent gloss.

🔷
Paint Protection Film

Self-healing PPF shields your paint from rock chips, scratches, and road debris. Invisible protection for the long haul.

⚙️
Powder Coating

Durable powder-coated finishes for wheels and trim. Weather-proof, corrosion-resistant, available in hundreds of custom colours.

🔧
Collision Repair

Accident and insurance-claim repairs handled with care. Niro keeps you updated every step of the way and meets deadlines every time.

✨
Star Light Roofs

Fibre optic LED star ceiling installations that transform your interior into a private planetarium. A signature AIM specialty.

🔵
Rims & Tires

Wheel upgrades, custom rims, and tire packages to complete the look of your build. Supply and install available.

📡
Immobilizers & Tracking

GPS tracking systems and immobilisers for complete peace of mind. Protect your investment with the latest security technology.

Our Story

Passion Meets
Precision

Art in Motion Auto Care was founded on a simple belief — your vehicle deserves to be treated like a work of art. Owner Niro Srikantharajah built AIM into the GTA's most trusted one-stop auto shop through relentless attention to detail, transparent communication, and a genuine passion for cars.

From daily drivers to brand-new exotics shipped straight from the dealership, every vehicle gets the same meticulous treatment. Niro and his team are known for meeting deadlines on the dot — even working after hours to ensure your car is ready when it needs to be.

  • Transparent pricing — we match competitor quotes
  • Real-time updates throughout your service
  • Exotic & luxury vehicle specialists
  • Rapid turnaround without cutting corners
  • Insurance & collision claim assistance
